title: Revert "cw-out: avoid nested flush when unpausing from a callback"
body:
This reverts commit e88cd7e106abda8404303879e09e2e4183b30bb7.

The tests were failing widely.

Ref: #23431

files.patch:
@@ -1,47 +0,0 @@
-<?xml version="1.0" encoding="US-ASCII"?>
-<testcase>
-<info>
-<keywords>
-HTTP
-HTTP GET
-CURLPAUSE_RECV
-libtest
-</keywords>
-</info>
-
-# Server-side
-<reply>
-<data crlf="headers" nocheck="yes">
-HTTP/1.1 200 OK
-Content-Length: 100001
-
-%repeat[10000 x 0123456789]%
-</data>
-</reply>
-
-# Client-side
-<client>
-<features>
-verbose-strings
-</features>
-<server>
-http
-</server>
-<name>
-unpause from the debug callback while replaying paused output
-</name>
-<command>
-http://%HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT/%TESTNUMBER
-</command>
-</client>
-
-# Verify data after the test has been "shot"
-<verify>
-<stdout>
-%repeat[10000 x 0123456789]%
-</stdout>
-<errorcode>
-0
-</errorcode>
-</verify>
-</testcase>

@@ -1,50 +0,0 @@
-<?xml version="1.0" encoding="US-ASCII"?>
-<testcase>
-<info>
-<keywords>
-HTTP
-HTTP GET
-CURLPAUSE_RECV
-libtest
-compressed
-</keywords>
-</info>
-
-# Server-side
-<reply>
-<data crlf="headers" nonewline="yes" nocheck="yes">
-HTTP/1.1 200 OK
-Content-Encoding: gzip
-Content-Length: 30023
-
-%hex[%1f%8b%08%00%00%00%00%00%00%03%01%30%75%cf%8a]hex%%repeat[30000 x A]%%hex[%22%05%a7%dc%30%75%00%00]hex%
-</data>
-</reply>
-
-# Client-side
-<client>
-<features>
-libz
-verbose-strings
-</features>
-<server>
-http
-</server>
-<name>
-callback unpause while replaying stored-block gzip input
-</name>
-<command>
-http://%HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT/%TESTNUMBER
-</command>
-</client>
-
-# Verify decoded bytes and the libtest's nested-event assertion
-<verify>
-<stdout nonewline="yes">
-%repeat[30000 x A]%
-</stdout>
-<errorcode>
-0
-</errorcode>
-</verify>
-</testcase>
